whathitme.hint.fall: Feather Falling boots, a water bucket or slow falling stop most fall damage.
whathitme.hint.elytra: Fly in straight lines and slow down before walls: elytra crashes ignore armor.
whathitme.hint.drown: Respiration, Water Breathing potions or a door / air pocket keep you breathing.
whathitme.hint.fire: Fire Resistance potions make you immune; Fire Protection reduces it. Jump into water to stop burning.
whathitme.hint.void: Nothing protects from the void. Build railings and keep an Ender Pearl ready.
whathitme.hint.starve: Keep food in your hotbar: starvation ignores armor.
whathitme.hint.suffocation: Do not stand where blocks or gravel can fall on your head.
whathitme.hint.cactus: Keep a block of space around cacti.
whathitme.hint.wither: Wither ignores armor. Drink milk to remove it, or raise your max health.
whathitme.hint.magic: Magic ignores armor. Drink milk against poison; Protection and Resistance still help.
whathitme.hint.lightning: Stay away from tall open spots during thunderstorms; use lightning rods from mods if you have them.
whathitme.hint.falling_block: Look up before mining: a helmet reduces falling block damage.
whathitme.hint.dragon_breath: Move out of the purple cloud and drink a Regeneration potion.
whathitme.hint.thorns: Thorns enchantments hurt back when you hit the wearer.
whathitme.hint.absolute: This damage ignores armor AND resistance. Only more max health or avoiding it helps.
whathitme.hint.explosion: Blast Protection reduces explosions a lot. Keep your distance from creepers and TNT.
whathitme.hint.bypasses_armor: Armor does not help against this. Raise your max health or look for a resistance against this damage type.
whathitme.hint.projectile: Block with a shield or use Projectile Protection; take cover from archers.
whathitme.hint.invisible: The attacker was invisible. Look for particles, or use Night Vision and light the area.
whathitme.hint.player: Another player did this. Better armor, a shield and a Golden Apple help in PvP.
whathitme.hint.melee: Better armor and the Protection enchantment reduce melee damage. A shield blocks it entirely.
whathitme.hint.generic: Better armor and the Protection enchantment reduce most damage.
whathitme.hint.freeze: Leather boots let you walk on powder snow. Get out of it quickly.
whathitme.hint.border: Go back inside the world border.
whathitme.vital: [Localized / Vital Hit (Died with %s total HP left)]
whathitme.hint.reflected: This damage came back from something you hit. Check your target for Thorns or reflection before attacking.
whathitme.error.internal: Something went wrong; the details were written to the log.
